text: {"lessons":["Doing nothing avoided unnecessary trades during the early rise, but it did not prevent the later decline; I should review risk regularly rather than assume holding is always safest.","A fall over several months is a reason to reassess my portfolio’s exposure and whether it suits my need for stable retirement income—not to make a rushed trade based on recent losses.","One sale of Stock E after a large gain does not show whether the timing was right; I should base future trades on my financial needs and considered reasons, not gains or losses alone."]}
